notes.title: Change of plans
notes.content:
[h3]I've decided to make Drunken Wrestlers 2 a paid game. I do not take this decision lightly. In fact, this is the hardest decision I've had to make in my entire life. However, I see no other way forward. Here are the three main factors that have contributed to this decision:[/h3]

[h1]1. Drunken Wrestlers 2 has suffered the same fate as Spacewar[/h1]
[h3]   Recently, pirates started abusing Drunken Wrestlers 2 to emulate online features in pirated games, similar to how Spacewar is used:[/h3]
https://youtu.be/Xg7_dD3-QTc
(Skip to [url=https://youtu.be/Xg7_dD3-QTc?t=464]7:44[/url] for the relevant part)

[h4]   Drunken Wrestlers 2 is free and utilizes pretty much every online feature available on Steam, so it's perfect for online feature emulation in pirated Steam games. I would probably be unaware of this if the Steam Workshop wasn't being flooded with items intended for other games.
Hundreds of files are uploaded to the Drunken Wrestlers 2 workshop every day, and at this point, almost 80% of all content there consists of unrelated items, such as card decks for the game Pic-Me![/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/130fc0160eb18da8987268a6229b76fe2f1f6c3e.png[/img]
[h5]   I've hidden more than 3000 of these items, but they keep coming, drowning the legitimate Drunken Wrestlers 2 mods. Take a look:[/h5]
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=667530&requiredflags%5B%5D=incompatible
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/e06e392c1aacd0b5208143cd74eb66ad9cd5b022.png[/img]

[h1]2. Drunken Wrestlers 2 has poor online servers because it's free[/h1]
[h4]   If you played this game in 2022, you'll remember how smooth the online servers felt compared to now. Today, disruptive lag spikes and ping issues are commonplace, and the competitive scene has almost dwindled. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/667530/announcements/detail/3634997551246427270]Many things in the world changed in 2022, including my financial situation[/url]. My savings were gone, and I was forced to downgrade the online servers to the most affordable ones I could find.[/h4]

[h5]   [url=https://x.com/skutteoleg/status/1702753403300892913]Drunken Wrestlers 2 was earning $0.023 per install[/url], and there was nothing I could do to make it more profitable without turning it into a microtransaction-ridden hellscape completely. I really didn't want to make Drunken Wrestlers 2 paid, so I've spent two years making two other games in hopes of selling enough copies to fund good servers for Drunken Wrestlers 2. One flopped, but the other is a moderate success. However, it has operational costs as well, so things still don't add up to cover the cost of good servers for Drunken Wrestlers 2.[/h5]

[h1]3. Free games are an easy target for bad actors[/h1]
[h3]   Free games, especially those with online multiplayer, are easy targets for those looking to ruin everyone's fun, be it by hacking the game or by spamming obscenities in chat. There is nothing stopping them from spoofing their ID and making a new Steam account after they get banned. Over the years, I've seen instances of people making hundreds of Steam accounts in an endless cat-and-mouse game. When a game is free, it's impossible to keep offenders banned without employing invasive and privacy-violating techniques.[/h3]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Making the game paid would solve all of these issues:[/h3]
[h5][list]
[*] Pirates will no longer be able to flood Steam Workshop.
[*] I would be able to afford good online servers.
[*] It would be much easier to deter bad actors.
[/list][/h5]

Of course, there are also downsides to this decision. The main downside is that the game will become less accessible, which may lead to fewer people playing it, making it harder to find online matches. However, I've looked at other games that have transitioned from free to paid, and the player count drop-off is much less pronounced than I anticipated.
[list]
[*] The player count drop-off was actually unnoticeable in the majority of cases that I looked at.
[*] The fact that the game was downloaded more than 6 million times across all platforms should also help retain some player base.
[*] It is very likely that I will publish a free demo with playable online multiplayer (with limited features of course, to avoid issues 1 & 3).
[*] The game will remain free on Android.
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/e4e52de3e9272a9e4fff5743a6c725711fd4cf2b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/e6a3200e513da27629e8e6338f1cb1b14f46891f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/1947b881cda234d0e1fd3dc793601139b6b5a1dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/7dd7b8487ec9051148368ded3896baa5cd3d1781.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/1b169aca596c58c5483b5319ce670650d8efc6e6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/1791d5164024e9dbbf0e2bd4327880a11ab0ab2b.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr][h2][list][*] The game will cost [b]$3.99[/b] in the United States, with fair regional pricing across the globe.
[*] If you already have the game in your Steam library, you will keep it (and all your items) even after it becomes paid.
[*] The change will take place in at least a week from now, possibly more (I'm aiming for February 15-17th).
[/list][/h2]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]A Word About Lack of Updates[/h2]
As mentioned previously, in 2022, I pivoted to making new games. Aside from the reasons mentioned above, this was also motivated by the fact that I was drowning in spaghetti code. Given that Drunken Wrestlers 2 is my first serious project and that I was learning as I went, it accumulated incredible amounts of technical debt over the 8 years I worked on it. Without throwing big parts of it away and starting from scratch, there was no longer any way to make progress. Starting from scratch would take another few years, and I cannot afford to invest that much time into a project without having some kind of passive income to sustain myself. The only reason I was able to develop Drunken Wrestlers 2 in the first place was because Drunken Wrestlers 1 was an infinite money glitch for a while.

[i]If there is demand, making Drunken Wrestlers 2 paid will allow me to take the time to rebuild it from scratch using all the knowledge and experience I've gained during my 12 years of making games. Imagine a game like Drunken Wrestlers 2, but
[list]
[*] Without all the jank
[*] With cohesive UI and art direction
[*] More reliable netcode (it's possible to implement rollback netcode if physics engine is deterministic)
[*] More extensive modding support
[*] The ability to create movesets
[/list][/i][i]- Oleg[/i]

notes.title: Online servers are going to be shut down on December 7th
notes.content:
Over the last few months my financial situation has worsened significantly.
1 USD is equal to 50-60 RUB now, while it used to be 70-80. So, for every US dollar, I now get 25% less Russian rubles.
On top of that, foreign banks now charge enormous fees for every transaction going into Russia. This month alone they charged about $250 in fees, which is more than half the cost of the servers per month.

[h3]For 2 months in a row I had to borrow money to pay my rent while I was prioritizing the servers, but I can't continue like this any longer.[/h3] [h2]I've decided to move out and leave Russia while the borders are still open. This will cost me a lot, and I won't be able to pay for the servers this month.

Servers will continue to operate until December 7th. After that, they will be shut down and will be back up [b]if/when[/b] I'll have enough money to pay for them.

[i]- Oleg[/i][/h2]

notes.content:
[h1]EDIT: We've raised over $500, and I am now able to pay for the servers! Thank you to everyone who contributed![/h1]
[i]If any of the contributors would like a shout out or some in-game reward feel free to DM me on Discord or by email[/i]

[h1]---[/h1]

Last month, the game had a huge and sudden spike in traction. Player count on Android at some point reached [b]100,000[/b] active players per day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/8bf4f1c36362d88c929fc8784b998b2b7d643f4e.png[/img]

[h3]This would be great news if not one problem: because of a spike in bandwidth usage, [b]server costs[/b] suddenly [b]went up[/b] as well.[/h3]

[h2]For the month of May, I have to pay [b]$890.43[/b] for the servers. If I don't pay until [b]7th of June[/b], the game will get limited to [b]20[/b] concurrent players.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/d4ce809fa5b82ad105cdeb4208f54bd5cf5de5de.png[/img]

I don't have so much money at the moment and am unable to pay. Revenue from last month will only arrive at the end of [b]June[/b].

[h3]Right now I could pay [b]~$400[/b] without the risk of starving or losing the roof over my head. But [b]~$500[/b] more would remain to be paid.[/h3]

[h2]If you happen to have spare money and are able to help, here is my PayPal:[/h2]
[h1]00.00.oleg.00.00@gmail.com[/h1]
[i](I would have set up a GoFundMe but it's not available in Russia)[/i]

If anybody decides to help, I'll update the news section in game with the progress towards this goal as often as I can (whenever I'm awake).

[h1]___[/h1]

[h3]WARNING: This update will reset your controls. Target switching is now Q and E by default. Just change the controls back if you feel like it. The controls got reset because controller support required rewriting the input system.[/h3]

The last couple weeks were spent mostly on catching and fixing bugs. This week I started to work on controller support.

[b]WARNING:[/b] Unfortunately your current keybind settings will be lost because i had to rewrite the input system from the ground up and it has a different serialization pattern now.

notes.title: Do not think this game is dead
notes.content:
Quick note for newcomers: [list][*] Despite being released on April 1st and being free, this is a real game i've put real effort into.
I'm seeing too many reviews from people who played ~0.3 hours and didn't give it a chance. Free price tag creates a false prejudice about poor quality which is enforced by any problem ran into.
If you're encountering any problems or have criticism please [url=discord.gg/dw2]contact me first[/url].
[/list][h1][u]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[/u][/h1]

[i]As some may have noticed, i've been a bit silent for the last few months. For more than a couple months there were no updates to the game.[/i]

[i]This game is dead[/i], you may think, looking at the latest build version and seeing the emptiness of the game's [i]News[/i] section on Steam.

This picture may start to form if you've never visited [i]the most convenient place to get the latest news about this game[/i], [b][url=discord.gg/dw2]Drunken Wrestlers 2 Discord server[/url][/b]. 

[h1][u]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[/u][/h1]

Few months ago i was actively pushing updates almost every day. It was mostly small bugfixes. I was fixing and improving the game for 3 months straight after the release. I think it was a success, seeing the positive reviews rise from 75% on release up to 92%. [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29326991/fac481a4b147ccc1688389379bcca8228f706aec.jpg[/img]
[b]At some point, i decided it was finally time to start moving forward with major features i was promising since the beginning.[/b]

And so, for the last months, me and my girlfriend were working on expanding customization options and building inventory and shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/f457ec1099ead48ad9e5f625f970de5dcc84804c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/80d28649bf85aecf8bbd274e36a7da7d25da038e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326991/1f82de350d024d604b565b630f59f36503342dd0.png[/img]

But a around a month ago, out of nowhere
[h1]Steam reviews started to suddenly go down[/h1][list][*] [i]I don't know the reason but I can imagine people starting to think this game is abandonware or the development is going nowhere.[/i]
[/list]
That is not true, and I have great plans for this game! [b]We're currently in the middle of preparing a big update[/b] that will include a lot of [b]new cosmetics[/b] and finally a way to spend ingame currency. On top of that, in the near future, i'm planning to implement [b]programmable workshop game modes[/b] support, which would give a lot of new possibilities and things to do in this game.

But, regional prices in Russia are almost half the prices in USD, so Russian players do not bring any money.[/i]

[h1]Drunken Wrestlers 1 got removed from Google Play.[/h1][list][*] [i]An outdated ad SDK was violating their policies. Just like that [b]I lost my main source of income[/b].  At this time i have no way of updating that game and appealing the removal. If DW2 monetization fails, it may be game over. So, any in-game purchases in the beta will be greatly appreciated.[/i]

notes.title: Kaspersky malware problem
notes.content:
[b]I got several people telling me that Kaspersky antivirus now says this game is a malware[/b] (UDS:DangerousObject.Multi.Generic).
This happened yesterday out of nowhere. At that moment, the game has not been updated since 16.05.2019, so i know that this happened not because of some change in the game.

[h1][b]Why it happened?[/b][/h1]
Everything was fine before, but i guess virus databases got updated yesterday or something, and it started falsely blocking the game. 

[h1][b]But what is causing it?[/b]
I don't know.[/h1]
[b]My best guess is that it's because of mod editor.[/b] The game can run user written C# code on workshop maps, which potentially might be dangerous. But there shouldn't be any serious concerns since user code can't access namespaces such as System.IO and System.Reflection and are overall restricted. You can also see user code for yourself before running it by opening workshop map in the editor.
If you don't trust random user maps, i have a special tag for maps that got tested and approved:
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=667530&requiredtags[]=Approved

[h1][b]Other reasons i can think of that could trigger antiviruses(?):[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The game looks at which processes are running when it launches. It searches for its launcher which protects integrity of game files. If the game does not find it, it shuts down
[*] Mod editor can launch external applications to edit user code
[*] Recent addition of ability to import your own 3D models into the editor? This was introduced a day later though (today).
[/list]

[h1]But as of now, i'm not 100% sure what exactly caused it.[/h1]

If you have any idea why this might have happened and what should i do, or if you find any actual security threats, please contact me via [url=discord.gg/dw2][b]Drunken Wrestlers 2 Discord server[/b][/url].
[b]Also if you're interested, all of the news, patch notes and development progress are posted there. [/b]

[i]- Oleg[/i]

notes.title: Why this game is Free
notes.content:
[b]TL;DR[/b]: [i]Please  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/697760/Drunken_Wrestlers_2_Original_Soundtrack/]buy the DLC[/url] so i can support the game :lunar2019wavingpig:[/i]
[h1][u]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[/u][/h1]
[h1][b]Ever since i started working on this game, i always knew that i want it being free.[/b][/h1]

[h1]⠀⠀Why?[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Free game equals broader audience[/b]
I don't have a budget nor time for marketing, and i know for a fact that it is almost impossible, especially in 2019, to succeed on Steam with no promotion.
Making the game paid would almost certainly ruin its chances to spread on its own. People are more likely to play a game they don't have to pay for.
[/list]

[h1]⠀⠀Can you do it?[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Kinda[/b]
Supporting a multiplayer game costs money. At launch, my budget would allow me to pay maintaining costs for up to 500 CCU. That's 500 people playing the game at the same time. Anything more that that and i'm in the red.
[b]UPD: Turns out the multiplayer hosting provider calculates CCU differently and we've already surpassed 500 CCU even though Steam says this game only has ~200 CCU daily. On top of that, this game surpasses traffic amount limits and additional fees are applied. I'm now completely reliant on DLC sales.[/b]
[/list]

[h1]⠀⠀Do you even have a plan?[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A theoretical one[/b]
A game, released out of nowhere with no marketing, shouldn't get too much traction. Meaning I won't have to spend loads of money on hosting, and deal with criticism from a lot of people. Having small but passionate audience filtered out would benefit the development.
And as the game progresses, hopefully the audience will slowly build.
[/list]

[h1]⠀⠀What if you suddenly get a lot of people playing your game?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hopefully it won't happen sooner than i add more customization possibilities and implement shop with ingame purchases. Otherwise i hope some of the players would be generous enough to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/697760/Drunken_Wrestlers_2_Original_Soundtrack/]buy the DLC[/url] (👀yes i'm looking at you👀). If not then i'm screwed :lunar2019grinningpig:
[/list]

[h1]⠀⠀Why wouldn't you release your game when you have all means to monetize it?[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]I just couldn't help myself[/b]
Releasing a game on April 1st felt like a joke i could only get a chance to execute once in a lifetime. The game is *almost* playable anyways.
[/list]

[h1]⠀⠀It's all good and all, but what about cheaters and toxic playerbase that comes with ⠀⠀free pricetag?[/h1]
[list]
[*] I took care of the game security to the best of my ability, and i'm not aware of any ways the game could be abused by toxic players. If any vulnerabilities or loopholes are found, i'll be quick to fix them.
[/list]

[h1]⠀⠀Anything more to say?[/h1]
[*] [i]Thanks for reading. Excuse my Russian punctuation habits.
Find more info or contact me: [url=https://discord.gg/dw2]DW2 Discord server[/url]
- Oleg[/i]
